text: A molehill, freshly heaped. {lead} drums a gentle rhythm on the ground and the worms come up to see what the fuss is. Among the soil: Four-Leaf Clover.
A cheese wheel stuck in a hollow, as they do. {lead} gives it a shove and down the slope it goes, and the hollow gives up Aneroid Barometer.
{lead} takes a run up and lofts the bowl clean over the verge. Where it comes down: Sloes.
The bog water is dark and cold. {lead} ploughs through it with its face down and surfaces holding Burn Water Flask.
A cheese wheel stuck in a hollow, as they do. {lead} gives it a shove and down the slope it goes, and the hollow gives up a roll of notes.
A glint under the surface, just out of reach. {lead} hooks it with patience and a bit of reed. It is Sea Glass.
